criteria.notes: Dinner menu board: venue identity, chef's selection, priced course sections, tonight's table and allergen footer, present across bound, unbound and empty states.
Editorial restaurant-menu concept preserved: serif wordmark, hairline rules, cream and near-black split, no card chrome.
Reads as a printed menu board rather than a data table; two-column course grid with a standing chef's panel.
Course names and prices sit well above the room-distance floors now that auto-fit reaches its intended size rather than the minimum.
Light-theme scenario keeps dark text on cream at full contrast; the default inverts cleanly without losing the price column.
Long-label and last-page scenarios wrap or repaginate; no ellipsis, no clipped price, no row collision at 1536x432.
Columns fill the plate on every surface; empty and bound-null states substitute a centred message rather than leaving the panel blank.
Wordmark and hairline rules render crisply at every size; no raster media to degrade.
Cream editorial typography is distinct from the dark accent-card language of the dashboard examples.
